ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extreme high-contrast distribution characterized by a ~85-90% concentration of low-intensity black pixels against 10-15% high-intensity white pixels located at the distal tips and localized surface markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous black pigmentation across the central fluke body; high-intensity white geometric patches at both lateral tips; distinct cluster of circular white pixel blobs on the right lobe surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a pixel-measured angle of approximately 65 degrees relative to the lobe axes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with high-frequency serrations; peak-to-valley amplitudes are greatest on the inner margins of both lobes, decreasing in frequency toward the tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong concave upward trajectory along the trailing edge, resulting in acute, upward-pointing distal extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Group of 4-6 distinct, roughly circular white pixel clusters on the right lobe; smaller individual high-intensity points scattered across the distal half of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple faint vertical linear pixel disruptions on the mid-left lobe; several short, unaligned diagonal white marks on the upper-right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Severely irregular and jagged pixel boundary at the left distal tip suggesting historical tissue loss; prominent isolated white mark located at the vertex of the median notch.
